lines.text: Do you know how a giant warehouse finds your order in minutes? The shelves come to the people.
Items aren't sorted neatly. A phone case might sit next to dog food, wherever there's space. The computer remembers every spot.
When you order, a small robot slides under the right shelf, lifts it, and drives it to a worker.
A light shows the exact bin. The worker grabs the item, scans it, and drops it in a tub.
Conveyor belts carry the tub to packing, where the screen even picks the right box size.
Every scan updates the system, so it always knows who's doing what, and what's done.
Orbi Work keeps a team in sync the same way. Type a task, tag a teammate, and watch it move from doing, to review, to done, live for everyone.
